subject: Vetted data analysts for your Product Data Analyst (L3) opening
body:
Hi Twilio team,

I saw you're hiring for Product Data Analyst (L3). Rather than sorting through
hundreds of cold applications, I can send you 2-3 candidates who are
trained, vetted, and ready to interview.

I run Data in Motion (https://datainmotion.co), a data analytics training community.
Our graduates are job-ready in SQL, Excel, Tableau/Power BI, and Python,
and I personally vouch for the people I refer.

The roles I'm referring to:
  - Product Data Analyst (L3) (Remote - India) — https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/twilio/jobs/8170601

Would you be open to a quick chat?

Best,
